items.title: D'Imperio interviewed by Monk Rowe, 2014
items.q: I walked into that thing, it was July of 1956. And at that time Jackie Gleason was big, but he would have a summer replacement and it was Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey.

ctx.x: But he wanted you to be.

Well he wanted me to be exposed to music. I’m not sure he wanted it to go quite the way it went, as you will find out later in the interview. But I walked into that thing, it was July of 1956. And at that time Jackie Gleason was big, but he would have a summer replacement and it was Tommy and Jimmy Dorsey. In fact, that summer replacement — one of the episodes of the summer replacement was when the juggler was on the show of the Dorsey Brothers, when Charlie Parker was watching it, as he died.
